message: Full unredacted REST API access requires an active Surplus Docket Enterprise subscription with a valid Bearer API token. Production feeds deliver unredacted claimant identities, verified property situs, and court docket links every business morning (Mon–Fri) at 7:00 AM EST.
delivery_schedule: Monday through Friday (Court Business Days) at 7:00 AM EST
